The '''Imperial Army-Navy Ordnance Center''' was located at [[Jyrenne Base]] in [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. It was [[Attack on the Imperial Army-Navy Ordnance Center|struck]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], crippling [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] supply efforts in the [[Airon sector/Legends|Airon sector]].
